replacement_rule: Keep each image path stable where possible; replace temporary SVG artwork with original WebP/JPEG while preserving intended composition.

video_policy.principle: The website is the portfolio and archive; public video platforms host playback; private cloud drives are for review, delivery and download only.
video_policy.github: Store HTML, CSS, JS, cover images, thumbnails and small previews only. Do not store full-resolution video masters.

antmonologue.playback: Embed a public platform player when available; otherwise link to the public watch page.

documentary_film.playback: Preserve each film's original aspect ratio; use public embeds or external watch links.

video_policy.platforms: Choose an accessible public platform per audience and verify embed availability before publishing.
